name: Sale Receipt
subject: Your receipt from {{ company_brand(doc.company).name }} — {{ doc.name }}
response_html:
{% set store = company_brand(doc.company).name %}

Hi {{ customer_name }},

{% set due = doc.rounded_total or doc.grand_total %}{% if due < 0 and not doc.is_return %}

Thank you for your trade. Your receipt for {{ doc.name }} is attached: we paid you {{ frappe.utils.fmt_money(0 - due, currency=doc.currency) }}{% if doc.get("ffl_trade_in_payout_method") %} by {{ doc.ffl_trade_in_payout_method | e }}{% endif %}.

{% else %}

Thank you for your purchase. Your receipt for {{ doc.name }} (total {{ doc.grand_total }}) is attached.

{% endif %}

— {{ store }}
